project.overviewDescription: CrewOps is a modern system designed for efficient management of technical crews and machinery in large-scale operations. The application integrates multiple modules to provide comprehensive support for daily operational needs.
project.whatIsDescription: CrewOps is an integrated management platform for technical teams and machinery. The system allows for efficient planning, monitoring, and reporting of field operations, offering real-time control over workforce and equipment.

useCases.construction: Construction companies managing multiple crews and heavy machinery across different sites
useCases.maintenance: Maintenance teams responsible for keeping critical infrastructure operational
useCases.manufacturing: Manufacturing facilities coordinating technical staff and specialized equipment
useCases.energy: Energy sector companies managing field technicians and power distribution equipment

uniqueFeatures.accessControl: Granular role-based access control system with detailed permission configuration
uniqueFeatures.teamAssignment: Advanced team and shift scheduling with real-time conflict detection
uniqueFeatures.machineLifecycle: Complete lifecycle management for machinery including assignment, service, and decommissioning
uniqueFeatures.faultManagement: Integrated fault reporting system with tracking, history, and automated notifications

deployment.container: Docker container deployment for easy setup and scaling
deployment.cloud: Cloud-ready architecture for deployment on any cloud provider
